name: PM-KISAN
description: Provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families who own cultivable land, paid in three equal instalments directly into bank accounts.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year (3 instalments of Rs 2,000)

eligibility.notes: Land must be in the farmer's name or family's name. Excludes income-tax payers, government employees, and large landholders (To be verified).

how_to_apply: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or apply online at pmkisan.gov.in. Village-level revenue officials or Patwari can also help with registration.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Extended in September 2024 to cover ALL senior citizens aged 70 and above regardless of income.
benefit: Health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year; all citizens aged 70+ get an additional Rs 5 lakh top-up cover

eligibility.notes: Two tracks: (1) BPL/SECC-listed families of any age get Rs 5 lakh cover. (2) ALL citizens aged 70 years and above (regardless of income or BPL status) are now covered under the September 2024 expansion — they get an additional Rs 5 lakh top-up card. Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in.

documents: Ration card (BPL / NFSA) — for non-senior-citizen track
Ayushman card (issued at empanelled hospitals or CSC)
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call helpline 14555. Senior citizens (70+) can self-enrol at any empanelled hospital or CSC from October 2024.

name: Ladli Behna Yojana
description: Madhya Pradesh government scheme providing monthly financial assistance to women to strengthen their economic self-reliance and improve nutrition.
benefit: Rs 1,500 per month (enhanced from Rs 1,250; amount subject to revision — verify at cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in)

eligibility.notes: Must be domiciled in Madhya Pradesh. Family income below Rs 2.5 lakh per year. Family must not own more than 5 acres of land. Income-tax payers and government employees excluded. Monthly amount enhanced to Rs 1,500 from 2024.

documents: Marriage certificate or widow certificate (as applicable)
how_to_apply: Apply online at cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in or visit your nearest Gram Panchayat / Ward Office. Camp-based registration is also conducted periodically.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) and other deprived households to protect their health and reduce indoor air pollution.
benefit: Free LPG connection (cylinder, regulator, and stove); subsidised refills

eligibility.notes: Must be an adult woman. Must belong to BPL household or specific deprived categories under SECC 2011 (SC/ST, PM Awas Yojana beneficiaries, MGNREGS job card holders, etc.). Must not already have an LPG connection. To be verified.

how_to_apply: Visit your nearest LPG distributor (Indian Oil / HP Gas / Bharat Gas) or apply online at pmuy.gov.in.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP). Provides monthly pension to elderly BPL persons. Most states add a significant top-up — actual pension received is often Rs 500–2000+ per month depending on state.
benefit: Rs 200–500/month from centre (age 60–79: Rs 200; age 80+: Rs 500) + state top-up (varies; e.g. MP adds Rs 300, total ~Rs 500/month for age 60–79)

eligibility.notes: Must be 60 years or older. Must belong to a BPL household. State governments operate their own pension schemes with higher amounts. To be verified.

documents: Age proof (birth certificate, school certificate, or Aadhaar)
how_to_apply: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, Block Development Office (BDO), or District Social Welfare Office. Forms are also available at the state social welfare department website.

name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural families to construct or upgrade a pucca (permanent) house with basic amenities.
benefit: Rs 1,20,000 (plains) or Rs 1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) per house unit; MGNREGS labour component of 90–95 days also provided

eligibility.notes: Priority given to SC/ST, freed bonded labourers, minorities, widows/kin of armed forces, persons with disabilities, and PMAY-G Awaiting List families based on SECC 2011. Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house. To be verified.

how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are selected from the SECC 2011 Awaiting List by Gram Sabha. Contact your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office. Check your name at pmayg.gov.in.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A small savings scheme for the education and marriage expenses of the girl child. Offers high interest rate and tax benefits.
benefit: 8.2% per annum interest (rate revised quarterly by MoF); tax exemption under Section 80C; lump sum at maturity (21 years from account opening or on marriage after age 18)

eligibility.notes: Account opened by parent/guardian for girl child up to age 10. Maximum 2 accounts per family (one per daughter). Account matures 21 years from date of opening or on marriage after age 18. To be verified.

how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorised bank branch (SBI, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, etc.).

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first living child to compensate for wage loss and improve health and nutrition.
benefit: Rs 5,000 in two instalments for first living child; Rs 6,000 for second child if she is a girl (under Mission Shakti component — verify at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in)

eligibility.notes: Applicable for first and second living child. Woman must not be a government employee receiving paid maternity leave. Must register pregnancy at Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or health facility. To be verified.

how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or Approved Health Facility. Apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
description: Scholarship for students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories pursuing education at post-matriculation (Class XI onwards) level.
benefit: Maintenance allowance Rs 230–1,200/month (day scholar) or Rs 380–1,200/month (hosteller) depending on level; full tuition fee reimbursement for students in government institutions; amounts may vary by state

eligibility.notes: Income limit: Rs 2.5 lakh for SC/ST and Rs 1 lakh for OBC per family per year (To be verified — OBC income limit may differ). Must be studying in recognised institution. Day scholars and hostellers have different allowance rates.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or the respective state scholarship portal.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services — savings, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension — to all unbanked households.
benefit: Zero-balance savings account; RuPay debit card with Rs 2 lakh accident insurance (enhanced 2018); Rs 30,000 life insurance for accounts opened by Aug 2018; overdraft of up to Rs 10,000 after 6 months of satisfactory operation

eligibility.notes: Open to any Indian citizen who does not already have a bank account. No minimum balance required.

documents: Aadhaar card (or any government-issued ID and address proof)
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) outlet. Fill in the account opening form with KYC documents.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector. Guarantees a fixed monthly pension after age 60.
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60, depending on contribution

eligibility.notes: Must be between 18–40 years. Must have a savings bank account. Must not be an income-tax payer (To be verified — rules may have changed). Must not be a member of any statutory social security scheme.

how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch, post office, or online through your bank's net banking / mobile banking app.

name: e-Shram Card
description: National database of unorganised workers. Provides a Universal Account Number (UAN), Rs 2 lakh accident insurance under PMSBY, and easier access to government social security schemes.
benefit: Rs 2 lakh accident insurance; one-stop identity for social security benefits; priority access to government welfare schemes

eligibility.notes: Must be an unorganised sector worker (not a member of EPFO/ESIC). Age 16–59. Must have a bank account and Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

documents: Bank account details (account number and IFSC)
how_to_apply: Self-register online at eshram.gov.in or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC).
